experimental_method: Rocking-cell (300 mL titanium) equilibrium; liquid sampled into a flask, evolved gas volume measured in a gasometer plus dissolved gas by mass/density correction; water activity checked after each run.
uncertainties_stated: Uc(T)=0.17 K, Uc(P)=0.068 MPa; per-point expanded uncertainty in x (k=2, 95%).
quality_remarks: Pure CO2 0.99995; salts 99.0-99.7% with no analytical check. Cell temperature obtained from jacket PRT via calibration T=0.9633 T_jacket + 0.9208. Brine: NaCl 7.013, CaCl2 0.737, MgCl2 0.087, KCl 0.066, SrCl2 0.059, BaCl2 0.036 wt%. Text quotes %AAD figures (4.71/3.00 single salt; 1.20/1.57 in conclusion) not reconciled by extractor.
